note: Sealed blind set of 160 synthetic Gmail-shaped messages (from, subject, snippet<=200 chars, date). Written without reading the classifier or any existing labeled mail. Kinds: received 25, rejection 30, interview 25, assessment 15, offer 10, recruiter_reply 15, other 40 (most 'other' are look-alikes sharing job words: card/loan/rental/admissions decisions, health assessments, scams, promos, job alerts, account notices). Snippets are plain text (no Gmail HTML entity escaping). One-way recorded video interviews are labeled assessment; live calls/screens/onsites (incl. Karat) are interview. company is null for other.
